pass_1.locations: Original Dölken 2008 publisher PDF pp.3 and 12, especially PDF text lines 679–713; TT-seq supplement lines 20–32 and ref.26 lines 1114–1117 establish inheritance; TT-seq source-bundle oligo scraper run first
pass_1.finding: Ref.26 is explicitly Dölken 2008. Its capture method uses EZ-Link Biotin-HPDP to derivatize 4sU, removes excess reagent, binds to µMACS streptavidin columns, washes, then elutes labeled RNA with DTT. TT-seq delegates purification to this method, so the reagent identity is source-supported, though TT-seq does not repeat its volumes.

pass_2.locations: TT-seq original supplementary methods lines 20–32 and reference 26 lines 1114–1117; Dölken 2008 original RNA publisher PDF web text lines 679–713, p.12
pass_2.finding: Independently confirmed TT-seq cites Dölken 2008 for purification. Dölken directly specifies 4sU thiol labeling with EZ-Link Biotin-HPDP, excess-biotin removal, capture on µMACS streptavidin beads/columns, washing, and DTT elution. This supports the inherited capture chemistry, not the later NuGEN adapter sequence.
